title: Ways to make 10p from 1p, 2p and 5p
caption: Split by the number of 5p coins: none leaves 10p for 1p and 2p (6 ways), one leaves 5p (3 ways), two leaves 0p (1 way): 10 in all, the coefficient of x¹⁰ in the generating function.
alt: Bar chart of ways by number of 5p coins used: 0 gives 6, 1 gives 3, 2 gives 1.
description: With k fives, the rest 10 − 5k is made from 1p and 2p: ⌊(10 − 5k)/2⌋ + 1 ways.
